content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is located in the NCR Biotech Science Cluster on the Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway in Faridabad. The institute carries out translational research and builds research collaborations to turn concepts into products that improve human health. Its centres include the Centre for Maternal and Child Health, the Centre for Tuberculosis Research, the Centre for Bio-design and Diagnostics and the Clinical Development Services Agency. All the posts in this notice are under research projects of BRIC-THSTI.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Laboratory Operations & Instrumentation: Contributes to the establishment and operationalization of the bioanalytical laboratory, including development and implementation of analytical workflows, laboratory processes, and documentation systems. Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain LC-MS/MS and HPLC systems to ensure reliable analytical performance. Support instrument qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and performance verification of laboratory equipment. Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure adherence to laboratory safety and good documentation practices. Provide routine supervision and technical guidance to junior analysts and laboratory staff. Oversee the maintenance of reference standards, reagent inventory, logbooks and lab notebooks. Bioanalytical Method Development & Validation: Prepare method development, validation, and analytical protocols for new projects after required literature search. Develop, optimize, and validate LC-MS/MS and HPLC methods for quantification of metabolites in biological matrices (e.g., plasma, serum, tissues). Generate analytical summaries, concentration datasets, and bioanalytical study reports in compliance with laboratory quality systems. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays, and serological assays. Experience in handling small animals, histopathology. Experience in isolating PBMCs and working knowledge of FACS. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays (PCR, rt-PCR), and serological assays (ELISA, multiplex antibody detection assays), Gene cloning, protein expression. Candidates having work experience in a BSL-3 (Biosafety Level 3) laboratory environment will be preferred. Preparation of recombinant plasmids. Preparation and culturing of Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains in the BSL-3 laboratory. Setting up biochemical, immunological and cell-based assays. Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and analyses in support of SiB program objectives. Collaborate with researchers and scientists to perform various technical tasks. Maintain accurate records of experiments, data, and results. Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in the laboratory. Provide support in the development and implementation of research protocols. To assist in any other works like fields/site visits related to projects or other scientific/ technical activities. Conducting/ handling pre-clinical animal studies, expert in cell culture, performing immunological Assays, FACS, Cell sorting etc., data analysis and report writing. Hands-on Experience in conducting/ handling animal studies, cell culture, molecular biology, microbiology, FACS and report writing.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates may walk in at 9:00 am on the date given for their post. Candidates who arrive after the time slot will not be entertained. Every candidate attending the written test/skill test/interview must deposit their mobile phone, together with a valid identity proof, at the reception. Both are returned only after the entire selection process is over. The selection is by written test/skill test/interview. If many candidates appear, screening will be done to limit the number to those with higher/relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q1. When is the THSTI walk-in interview in 2026?
faq.answer: The dates are 4 November 2026 for Project Research Scientist-II, and 5 November 2026 for Lab Technician and Project Research Scientist-I. On 6 November 2026 the walk-in is for Project Research Scientist-III and Project Technical Support-III (S.No. 7). On 17 November 2026 it is for Project Technical Support-II and Project Technical Support-III (S.No. 3).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the THSTI walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates may walk in at 9:00 am at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001. Anyone who arrives after the time slot will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies, one in each of the 7 posts in Recruitment Notice No. THS/RN/22/2026. The notice says the number of vacancies may change according to the actual requirement at the time of the written test/skill test/interview.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the THSTI project posts?
faq.answer: The qualification differs for each post. Project Research Scientist-II, for example, needs a PhD (awarded) in any branch of Life Sciences with the specified research experience. Lab Technician needs a B.Sc. or a three-year diploma in Engineering/ Technology, with experience in Phlebotomy, saliva collection, NP swab collection, ELISA, PCR, culture etc.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for Project Research Scientist-III, 30 years for Project Technical Support-II, 35 years for both Project Technical Support-III posts and Project Research Scientist-I, 40 years for Project Research Scientist-II and 50 years for Lab Technician. Age is counted on the walk-in date of each post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for THSTI project posts?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated emoluments are Rs. 78,000/- plus HRA (Project Research Scientist-III), Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA (Project Research Scientist-II), Rs. 56,000/- plus HRA (Project Research Scientist-I), Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA (Project Technical Support-III), Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA (Project Technical Support-II) and Rs. 28,520/- (Lab Technician).

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the THSTI pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice prints "plus HRA" for every Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support post. The Lab Technician pay is printed as Rs. 28,520/- with no HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the THSTI walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring your latest CV/resume, one set of photocopies of your educational qualification and experience documents, the originals of those documents, and a valid ID card for verification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected at THSTI?
faq.answer: Selection is by written test/skill test/interview on the walk-in date. If many candidates appear, they will be screened down to those with higher/relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Are the THSTI project posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. These are short-term positions, and an extension depends on satisfactory performance and on the tenure of the project. Those appointed will have no claim to regularization of their employment.
